title: Covent Garden — neighbourhood dining and celebrations to welcome 2027

facts.fact: The neighbourhood operator explicitly invites visitors to welcome 2027 with dinners, bars and accommodation options; it does not guarantee a free street countdown or fireworks view.
facts.excerpt: spend your night welcoming in 2027 with us.

facts.fact: Dining choices span Seven Dials and Neal’s Yard; each restaurant/bar has its own booking and programme, so no blanket admission applies to all venues.
facts.excerpt: From trendy eateries nestled in the vibrant Seven Dials district, to the cosy nooks of Neal’s Yard
